scenario: [LSIG.1.4.1]: a rising edge is exactly the absorption of a `true` while the slot holds `false`. `onset_rate sliding 20s` on `Door.state` absorbs `true`, `true`, `true`, `true`, `false`, `true` at 1 to 6 s. `Door` is `logical` and its second mutable slot `n` changes at each assert, so each is a supersede that adds a sample rather than a no-op reassert. The first `true` follows nothing, the next three follow a `true`, and only the `true` at 6 s follows a `false`: one edge. At 7 s a `Probe` reads one edge in (-13 s, 7 s] over min(20 s, 7 s - 1 s): 1/6. A runtime that counts a first `true` reads 2/6, and one that counts every `true` reads 5/6. Path: libds `ds_series_ring_buffer_update_bool`'s edge test against `last_bool`, and `ds_series_ring_buffer_onset_rate_at`; Mercury `ds.series` `rising_edges`, which judges each sample against the one it follows.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Door scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Bool mutable
    n: Int mutable

schema Probe scope explicit:
    k: Int

series Door.state (by: entity_id):
    onset_rate sliding 20s

rule read:
    Probe
    Door d
->
    log info "{d.onset_rate}"
